sections.Profile:
"Time Line" is a pinball machine released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in December 1980, featuring a sci-fi and time-travel theme. It has a wide body cabinet with four flippers, no ramps, and does not include a multiball mode. Designed by Allen Edwall with artwork by Gerry Simkus, it is part of the Gottlieb System 80 series with 3,167 units produced.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1980
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
